brief:
A Palestinian man died on Sunday morning from wounds sustained when Israeli occupation forces shot him in al-Musaddar village in central Gaza, Wafa reported. The circumstances surrounding the shooting were not detailed.

In a separate incident, settlers attacked Palestinian olive harvesters, according to Middle East Eye. The report did not specify the location or extent of injuries from the settler attack.
dek: Palestinian injured in Israeli fire succumbs, settlers attack olive harvesters A Palestinian man died on Sunday morning from wounds sustained when Israeli occupation forces shot him in al-Musaddar village, in the central Gaza Strip, Wafa reported.
title: Palestinian dies from Israeli gunfire wound in Gaza
